tools.name: jarvis_set_api_key
tools.description: Set the Ollama API key for the current process. Overrides any OLLAMA_API_KEY env var or ?api= query param. The key is sent as Authorization: Bearer on every ollama request. Pass an empty string to clear.

key.description: Ollama API key, or empty string to clear

tools.name: jarvis_check_score
tools.description: Score how robotic a text sounds from 0.0 (fully robotic) to 1.0 (fully natural). Combines ZeroGPT and HumanizeAI.pro signals.

tools.name: jarvis_humanize_text
tools.description: Rewrite text through a multi-pass detector-bypass pipeline. Optionally runs a final grammar/professional LLM pass.

useLLM.description: Run a final LLM grammar pass (slower)

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List locally available Ollama models.

tools.name: ollama_health
tools.description: Check whether Ollama is reachable and list loaded models.

tools.name: deepthink_generate
tools.description: Run a prompt through Deepthink-JS multi-stage reasoning (depth + checks + MCTS). Returns a typed string.

tools.name: deepthink_json
tools.description: Same as deepthink_generate but guarantees a parsed JSON object back.

tools.name: deep_research
tools.description: Run a 9-step research pipeline: query planning, parallel web crawling, credibility scoring, MMR filtering, fact verification, report writing, critique loops.

tools.name: ollama_chat
tools.description: Direct (non-deepthink) Ollama chat call. Streams tokens out via jarvis:token events.

tools.name: jarvis_process
tools.description: High-level autonomous task execution: plan → MCTS-approved tool calls → verify → synthesize.

tools.name: jarvis_plan
tools.description: Just plan — return the JSON plan without executing.

tools.name: jarvis_mcts_search
tools.description: Run a real Monte Carlo Tree Search over a list of candidate tool calls and return the best one. Each candidate is {tool, params, narration}.

goal.description: What the agent is trying to accomplish

tools.name: jarvis_beam_search
tools.description: Cheaper alternative to MCTS — LLM ranks a flat list of candidate actions and returns the top-k.

tools.name: jarvis_agent
tools.description: Run a JSON-graph agent program. See the runtime docs for the full node-type reference.

tools.name: jarvis_shell
tools.description: Run a shell/bash command. Mutations are tracked for rollback.

tools.name: jarvis_powershell
tools.description: Run a PowerShell (Windows) or bash (Linux/macOS) command.

tools.name: jarvis_js_execute
tools.description: Run sandboxed JavaScript in a fresh Node subprocess.

tools.name: jarvis_python_run
tools.description: Run Python code or a script file via python3.

tools.name: jarvis_node_run
tools.description: Run a Node.js script or inline code.

tools.name: jarvis_git
tools.description: Run a git command in a given directory.

tools.name: jarvis_read_file
tools.description: Read a file. For known document types (.pdf, .docx, .xlsx, .csv, .html, .md, .json) returns parsed content; otherwise returns the raw text.

tools.name: jarvis_write_file
tools.description: Write to a file (tracked for rollback).

tools.name: jarvis_list_dir
tools.description: List files/dirs at a path.

tools.name: jarvis_create_dir
tools.description: Create a directory (recursive).

tools.name: jarvis_delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file (tracked for rollback).

tools.name: jarvis_copy_file
tools.description: Copy a file. Destination is recorded for rollback.

tools.name: jarvis_rollback
tools.description: Undo all filesystem mutations made in the current session.

tools.name: jarvis_web_search
tools.description: Search DuckDuckGo and rank results by source credibility.

tools.name: jarvis_web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return clean readable text.

tools.name: jarvis_http_request
tools.description: Make a raw HTTP/HTTPS request with optional headers/body.

tools.name: jarvis_open_url
tools.description: Open a URL in the default system browser.

tools.name: jarvis_system_info
tools.description: Get host system information.

tools.name: jarvis_list_processes
tools.description: List running processes.

tools.name: jarvis_kill_process
tools.description: Kill a process by PID or name.

tools.name: jarvis_env_var
tools.description: Get or set an env var.

tools.name: jarvis_wait
tools.description: Sleep for N ms (max 60s).

tools.name: jarvis_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the screen (Linux via scrot, macOS via screencapture).

tools.name: jarvis_mouse_move
tools.description: Move the OS mouse cursor.

tools.name: jarvis_mouse_click
tools.description: Click the OS mouse at (x, y).

tools.name: jarvis_type_text
tools.description: Type text via simulated keystrokes.

tools.name: jarvis_get_clipboard
tools.description: Read the OS clipboard.

tools.name: jarvis_set_clipboard
tools.description: Write to the OS clipboard.

tools.name: jarvis_ai_analyze
tools.description: Ask a model to answer a question about a data blob.

tools.name: jarvis_analyze_image
tools.description: Analyze a base64-encoded image with a multimodal model.

tools.name: jarvis_design_svg
tools.description: Iteratively draft an SVG from a reference image (or goal) using a vision-capable Ollama model. Loops draft→render→critique→revise until score ≥ threshold or N iterations.

source.description: image source: data url, file path, http(s) url, base64 string, or "clipboard"

model.description: explicit vision model; auto-pick from installed list if omitted

threshold.description: stop early if critic score ≥ threshold (default 90)

outFile.description: optional .svg file path to save the final draft

outPng.description: optional .png file path to save the rendered final draft

tools.name: jarvis_list_skills
tools.description: List available artifact-generation skills (excel, csv, markdown, html-report, json-spec, …).

tools.name: jarvis_run_skill
tools.description: Run a registered skill by name with a JSON input. See jarvis_list_skills for what is available. Use specFromGoal:true + goal:"..." to let the model derive the spec.

input.description: skill input — shape depends on the skill; see jarvis_list_skills

tools.name: jarvis_search_code
tools.description: ripgrep-style search across a directory tree, with optional regex and file-pattern filter.

tools.name: jarvis_find_files
tools.description: Find files by glob-ish name pattern under a root.

tools.name: jarvis_project_overview
tools.description: Quick stats on a project: file count, total LOC, top extensions, top directories.

tools.name: jarvis_import_map
tools.description: Build a quick import/require map of a JS/TS project.

tools.name: jarvis_list_functions
tools.description: Lightweight function/arrow detection in a single file.

tools.name: jarvis_audit_deps
tools.description: Audit a package.json: list installed vs missing dependencies and report the project's metadata.

tools.name: jarvis_parse_document
tools.description: Parse a PDF, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, HTML, Markdown, or JSON file into structured content.

tools.name: jarvis_memory_set
tools.description: Store a value in the persistent memory store. Optional TTL in ms.

dedup.description: Skip if an identical value already exists

tools.name: jarvis_memory_get
tools.description: Read a value from the memory store by namespace + key.

tools.name: jarvis_memory_search
tools.description: Substring search across a memory namespace.

tools.name: jarvis_memory_list
tools.description: List all keys in a memory namespace.

tools.name: jarvis_memory_delete
tools.description: Delete a value from the memory store.

tools.name: jarvis_memory_gc
tools.description: Sweep all expired TTL entries from the memory store.

tools.name: get_current_time
tools.description: Returns the current date/time on the server.

tools.name: roll_dice
tools.description: Roll an N-sided dice.

tools.name: coin_flip
tools.description: Flip a coin.

tools.name: echo_message
tools.description: Echo a message back (useful for connectivity tests).

tools.name: random_number
tools.description: Random integer in [min, max].

tools.name: get_event_log
tools.description: Tail the internal MCP event log. Optional channel filter and since-ms timestamp.
